responsibility: Implements the frontend-facing bridge by which language front ends provide translation-unit-specific constants to the analyzer. At end-of-TU it queries a translation_unit implementation for selected named integer constants, stores them in a GC-managed identifier-to-INTEGER_CST map, and exposes lookup/logging helpers so analyzer models such as file-descriptor handling can use header-derived macro or enum values instead of hardwired target assumptions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the translation-unit hook and constant-stashing machinery: it queries frontend-provided translation_unit objects for selected names, records INTEGER_CST values in a GC-managed map, and provides lookup/logging helpers. Unlike analyzer-language.h, it contains the concrete storage and end-of-TU behavior.
